description: Category 1 (numerical) questions with integer answers, authored from the challenge sample questions and reference images in questions/livingroom_2/questions.pdf. Objects are restricted to salient, visually verifiable furniture and decor so a human can confirm every answer from the scene. Each question carries a machine-readable spec that scripts/eval/verify_benchmark2.py re-evaluates against the iref_vla object bounding boxes.
notes: Q01 is the official Category 1 sample question from questions/livingroom_2/questions.pdf; its answer (2) is the answer printed in the PDF.
difficulty: easy = single salient object class; medium = one relation or a room-region restriction; hard = two chained relations.
The scene is split into iref regions: region 0 is the apartment (kitchen + living area), region 1 is the outdoor terrace. Region-scoped questions use that split.
Q03 and Q06 are deliberately paired: three of the four lamps are on the terrace, so a model that ignores the location qualifier gets one of them wrong.

Only large, unambiguous objects are counted. Spot lights, candles, small decorations and structural classes (wall/floor/ceiling) are excluded because they are too small or too abstract to ground reliably.
The TV is annotated twice (8 and 9) in the iref data, so no question counts televisions.
object_ids lists supporting iref_vla scene-graph ids for auditing; SAM3 should use target_objects.

questions.question: How many cups are on the coffee table?
questions.evidence: A white mug (48) and a coffee cup (12) stand on coffee table 83.

questions.question: How many couches are on the terrace?
questions.evidence: Three outdoor couches (6, 24, 60) form a U around the terrace table.

questions.question: How many lamps are in the scene in total?
questions.evidence: Three terrace lamps (15, 17, 72) plus the tall standing lamp indoors (81).

questions.question: How many stools are at the kitchen island?
questions.evidence: Two red bar stools (25, 56) are pulled up to the island.

questions.question: How many pillows are on the sofa?
questions.evidence: Three pillows (5, 22, 39) lie on the indoor sofa 71.

questions.question: How many lamps are on the terrace?
questions.evidence: Lamps 15, 17 and 72 are outside on the terrace (iref region 1); lamp 81 is indoors.

questions.question: How many potted plants are on the terrace?
questions.evidence: Two large planted trees (34, 58) stand on the terrace; the third potted plant (64) is indoors beside the TV cabinet.

questions.question: How many shelves of the bookcase are filled with books?
questions.evidence: Bookcase 29 has four stacked rows of books (14, 33, 16, 45).

questions.question: How many beer bottles are on the terrace table?
questions.evidence: Beer bottles 13 and 27 stand on terrace table 41, alongside a can of coke that is not counted.

questions.question: How many slices of bread are on the counter with the wine bottle on it?
questions.evidence: Wine bottle 66 stands on kitchen island 61, which also holds the two bread slices 46 and 47; the whole loaf (36) is not a slice.
